document.sourceMarkdown:
# B2B Terms

Revision 8 / Governance correction published 2026-11-23

## English

### 1. Administrator and service provider

SeedTrade.eu platform administrator: MB "Gate-V", company registration number 306795035.

Service provider: MB "Gate-V", a Lithuanian small partnership registered in the Lithuanian Register of Legal Entities on 2024-05-22. Registered address: Varnėnų g. 52, LT-37171 Panevėžys, Lithuania. VAT ID LT100017200917. Service, privacy and reporting contact: info@seedtrade.eu, in Lithuanian or English. Effective 2026-11-13.

### 2. Professional use, fees and agreement

B2B V1 is free and for business entities and authorized representatives acting professionally; consumer personal purchasing is excluded. Representatives must be authorized to register and accept these Terms for the business, provide accurate details and report when authority ends.

The platform agreement begins when a pending account and acceptance of the exact Terms/declaration versions are saved. This does not approve the company. Verification-mail failure does not undo a saved account; do not register repeatedly when delivery is uncertain. Providing privacy information is not blanket data-processing consent or marketing permission.

### 3. Approval and security

Trading requires verified email and separate company review by an authorized platform administrator. The platform owner determines company eligibility and which administrators may review companies, including owner-affiliated companies. Approval requires sufficient legal registration details and an explicit, reasoned administrator decision; it does not require a company-wide Buyer/Seller selection. Relevant profile changes return the company to review and published offers to draft. Email verification proves mailbox control; company approval does not guarantee solvency, goods, certification or legality. Protect credentials and report suspected unauthorized access to info@seedtrade.eu.

### 4. Offers and business transactions

Approved companies can prepare and publish supported seed offers, enquire about another company's offer, reply and close offers or exchanges. Other approved companies see exposed company-name/offer fields; participants and administrators performing necessary authorized functions can access their shared thread. Submission does not automatically publish complete profiles or messages. Public website listings and account-based offers are separate flows.

Businesses agree their own goods, price, contract, payment and delivery and meet applicable seed/product obligations. The platform has no payment collection, escrow, delivery or automatic sale-contract execution. Account use does not itself make the administrator a party to a sale. Market indicators are not individual quotations or transaction guarantees. Seller declarations and company approval are not product certification.

### 5. Content and permitted use

Submit lawful, accurate content you are authorized to disclose. Do not impersonate, bypass security, spam, offer unlawful goods or infringe rights. Avoid unnecessary sensitive or third-party data. Responsibility for submitted content does not remove the administrator's legal duties.

Users retain content rights and grant only non-exclusive permission to store, process and display content to intended lawful recipients as necessary for the service, security and lawful moderation. This grants no unrelated marketing, resale or model-training permission. Platform/source material retains its applicable rights and licences.

### 6. Service messages

Service mail covers verification, requested verification resends and implemented enquiry/seller-reply notices. These do not subscribe anyone to newsletters. Registration does not enable optional marketing or non-essential analytics. The separate Privacy Notice describes processing and rights.

### 7. Reports, decisions and review

Report potentially illegal content to info@seedtrade.eu or follow /legal/report/ instructions; no account is needed. Identify the exact location/record, reasons, good-faith accuracy statement and contact where lawfully required, subject to applicable statutory identity exceptions. Do not transmit unnecessary unlawful material.

An authorized human assesses the notice, evidence and urgency; records grounds, action, scope, duration and time; and provides applicable reasons, notifications and remedies. Automated illegality decisions are not used. Reconsideration is available through the same inbox, with another human where practicable. Seven working days is an ordinary internal response target; urgent action and mandatory deadlines take priority. Where DSA Article 20 applies, complaints remain possible for at least six months from notification, with applicable out-of-court and judicial remedies preserved.

### 8. Restrictions and closure

Proportionate restrictions may address credible security threats, suspected unlawful use, lost authority or binding lawful orders. Reasons are provided promptly except where lawfully restricted. Ordinarily allow seven calendar days to remedy a non-urgent remediable breach before termination. Company restriction is not described as removing only one item.

Authorized representatives can request closure at info@seedtrade.eu at any time without a V1 closure fee. Authority is checked, open exchanges addressed and a reasonable secure route provided to lawfully available records. Closure does not indiscriminately erase counterparties' records or justified evidence. Ordinary operator discontinuance or material Terms changes receive 30 calendar days' notice, subject to lawful urgent exceptions and mandatory rules. Renewed affirmative acceptance is obtained where required.

### 9. Rights, liability and versions

Applicable statutory liability, governing-law and jurisdiction rules apply. These Terms impose no additional monetary liability cap or exclusive chosen court. Contacting info@seedtrade.eu does not restrict legal remedies. Immutable accepted document versions remain available and historical acceptance is not rewritten. These Terms take effect on 2026-11-13.

document.title: Privacy Notice
document.sourceMarkdown:
SEEDTRADE.EU — Privacy Notice V1.0

1. Information we use

SEEDTRADE.EU uses personal data to provide its professional B2B platform. Registration collects company legal name, registration country and number, registered address, business email, and the representative's first and last name. VAT details are optional where applicable. After email verification, you set a password, which is stored as a hash. Existing company profiles may also contain representative roles, phone numbers, business activities and species.

We record email verification, company-review decisions and evidence of Terms acceptance, representative authority and Privacy Notice presentation. When marketplace functions are enabled, we process listings, enquiries, requested quantities, replies, participants and dates, including commercial information you provide. Each listing's brokerage acceptance records the company, user, listing, terms version and hash, and time. An enquiry confirmation uses a single-use email link and the exact summary accepted by its sender. Only after confirmation is the enquiry and necessary contact information sent to MB Gate-V's configured coordination mailbox for manual brokerage. Business data can identify people, particularly named contacts and sole traders.

We also use account-security, session, verification and recovery records; notification delivery records; support, rights and moderation correspondence; and relevant request and error logs. The separate business-interest form collects company, email, role, country and submission time. We receive information from you, authorised company members, counterparties and service providers, and may use identified public or business sources for catalogue and listing information. Editorial photographs may include creator credits and source/licence references. Please avoid unnecessary personal or sensitive information.

Dedicated administrators use separate credentials and mandatory multi-factor authentication. We keep password hashes, encrypted authenticator enrollment information and security-confirmation records. Identity enrollment does not itself grant company-review authority or assert a complete personal-affiliation list. Operational review permissions and applicable conflict restrictions are handled separately. Administrator sessions last up to thirty minutes. These access limits do not determine when the related records are deleted.

2. Purposes and lawful bases

Our legitimate interests are providing professional accounts, reviewing company eligibility, enabling business offers and conversations, delivering service messages, preventing misuse, handling disputes and keeping the service secure and recoverable (GDPR Article 6(1)(f)). We use only information necessary for these purposes, subject to individuals' rights and reasonable expectations.

Contract necessity (Article 6(1)(b)) applies only where you personally are a party to the relevant contract, or request steps before entering it, and the processing is necessary. Your employer's contract does not by itself provide this basis for processing your data as its representative.

We process information to meet applicable legal obligations, including GDPR rights requests, required breach handling and binding lawful demands (Article 6(1)(c)). Required registration and eligibility information is needed for the relevant service; additional commercial details are optional. Terms acceptance is not GDPR consent or marketing permission. Company approval involves human review, not a solely automated decision with legal or similarly significant effects.

3. Who receives information

Eligible approved members see published offer information and seller company identity. Authorised company participants see their conversations. Private profiles, credentials and messages are not generally public. SEEDTRADE.EU Administration and service providers receive access only as needed for their tasks. Trading counterparties may be separate controllers of information they receive. We may disclose information where necessary for legal obligations, claims or safety.

If a seller expressly confirms public preview for a published offer, anyone may see its species, variety, origin country, quantity and unit, certification/category and availability. Public preview excludes prices, seller identity, direct contacts, private specifications and conversations.

Hostinger provides our website hosting, API/database infrastructure and transactional email under its applicable standard service terms and Data Processing Addendum. The Addendum covers hosting, VPS and email and provides contractual transfer safeguards, including EU Standard Contractual Clauses where applicable. Our recorded provider information identifies Lithuania for primary website hosting, Paris, France for the API/database, and France/Germany at email-product level. These primary/product locations do not establish that all support, administrative, backup or onward processing remains within the EEA.

Our recovery arrangements include encrypted database, application and private-configuration snapshots on the API server and protected local recovery copies. Database snapshots can contain account and Marketplace records present when they are made. Authorised recovery verification can require decrypted data within a restricted recovery location. Server archives are restricted to the server administrator; the local recovery directory restricts access to the computer owner, SYSTEM and Administrators. These technical permissions do not establish the countries from which people access recovery copies or identify any additional recipients.

Dropbox retains historical recovery files, including three production archives encrypted before storage there. The recorded database snapshot of 10 November 2026 had empty application tables and predates the current Member and administrator records. Current database and administrator recovery snapshots are established on the API server and in protected local recovery storage; the inspected configuration does not establish a current automated upload of these snapshots to Dropbox. This is not an account-wide claim that no other copy exists or that historical archives contain no personal information. Dropbox is not part of the registration or enquiry request path. Its standard Terms of Service and Privacy Policy govern use of the service and describe account, file, usage and sharing metadata processing, possible processing in the United States and other countries, and applicable transfer mechanisms. Those public policies do not establish a Business processor agreement for this non-team account or the membership of the shared recovery folder.

Contact info@seedtrade.eu for information about recipients, processing locations and how to obtain a copy of applicable transfer safeguards.

4. How long information is kept

Retention depends on whether information is still needed for an account, business exchange, support case, legal duty, claim or proportionate security and recovery purpose. We review erasure requests manually and assess any lawful need to retain particular records. Closing an account or withdrawing an offer does not automatically erase counterparties' conversations or necessary acceptance evidence.

Verification links are valid for 30 minutes, password-reset links for 15 minutes and sessions for up to eight hours. These limits end their use; they do not mean every related record is deleted then. Password reset invalidates existing sessions. Logs and backup copies have separate retention considerations. The recovery procedure requires erasure decisions to be reapplied before restored service reopens. No fixed deletion or backup-rotation period is promised here.

5. Cookies and browser storage

A necessary secure session cookie keeps members signed in for up to eight hours. Your chosen language is stored in your browser until changed or cleared. Password-reset credentials are not saved in browser storage. Non-essential analytics and marketing tags are disabled.

6. Your rights

Subject to GDPR conditions, you may request access, correction, erasure, restriction or portability. You may object to processing based on legitimate interests; we must then stop unless we demonstrate compelling overriding grounds or need the information for legal claims. Contact info@seedtrade.eu. We verify requests proportionately and protect other people's information when responding.

We normally respond within one month. Any permitted extension of up to two further months is explained within the first month. You may complain to Lithuania's State Data Protection Inspectorate (VDAI) or another competent supervisory authority, including where you live or work. Material changes to this Notice will be communicated as appropriate. English is the authoritative legal language.

7. Data Controller and Contact

The controller operating SEEDTRADE.EU is MB "Gate-V", a Lithuanian mažoji bendrija, company code 306795035, registered in Lithuania's Register of Legal Entities (Juridinių asmenų registras). Registered address: Varnėnų g. 52, LT-37171 Panevėžys, Lithuania. VAT: LT100017200917. SEEDTRADE.EU is a platform name, not a separate company.

For privacy and service questions, contact the SEEDTRADE.EU team at info@seedtrade.eu.

Contract necessity (Article 6(1)(b)) applies only where you personally are a party to the relevant contract, or request steps before entering it, and the processing is necessary. Your employer's contract does not by itself provide this basis for processing your data as its representative.

We process information to meet applicable legal obligations, including GDPR rights requests, required breach handling and binding lawful demands (Article 6(1)(c)). Required registration and eligibility information is needed for the relevant service; additional commercial details are optional. Terms acceptance is not GDPR consent or marketing permission. Company approval involves human review, not a solely automated decision with legal or similarly significant effects.

sections.heading: 3. Who receives information
sections.text:
Eligible approved members see published offer information and seller company identity. Authorised company participants see their conversations. Private profiles, credentials and messages are not generally public. SEEDTRADE.EU Administration and service providers receive access only as needed for their tasks. Trading counterparties may be separate controllers of information they receive. We may disclose information where necessary for legal obligations, claims or safety.

If a seller expressly confirms public preview for a published offer, anyone may see its species, variety, origin country, quantity and unit, certification/category and availability. Public preview excludes prices, seller identity, direct contacts, private specifications and conversations.

Hostinger provides our website hosting, API/database infrastructure and transactional email under its applicable standard service terms and Data Processing Addendum. The Addendum covers hosting, VPS and email and provides contractual transfer safeguards, including EU Standard Contractual Clauses where applicable. Our recorded provider information identifies Lithuania for primary website hosting, Paris, France for the API/database, and France/Germany at email-product level. These primary/product locations do not establish that all support, administrative, backup or onward processing remains within the EEA.

Our recovery arrangements include encrypted database, application and private-configuration snapshots on the API server and protected local recovery copies. Database snapshots can contain account and Marketplace records present when they are made. Authorised recovery verification can require decrypted data within a restricted recovery location. Server archives are restricted to the server administrator; the local recovery directory restricts access to the computer owner, SYSTEM and Administrators. These technical permissions do not establish the countries from which people access recovery copies or identify any additional recipients.

Dropbox retains historical recovery files, including three production archives encrypted before storage there. The recorded database snapshot of 10 November 2026 had empty application tables and predates the current Member and administrator records. Current database and administrator recovery snapshots are established on the API server and in protected local recovery storage; the inspected configuration does not establish a current automated upload of these snapshots to Dropbox. This is not an account-wide claim that no other copy exists or that historical archives contain no personal information. Dropbox is not part of the registration or enquiry request path. Its standard Terms of Service and Privacy Policy govern use of the service and describe account, file, usage and sharing metadata processing, possible processing in the United States and other countries, and applicable transfer mechanisms. Those public policies do not establish a Business processor agreement for this non-team account or the membership of the shared recovery folder.

Contact info@seedtrade.eu for information about recipients, processing locations and how to obtain a copy of applicable transfer safeguards.

sections.heading: 4. How long information is kept
sections.text:
Retention depends on whether information is still needed for an account, business exchange, support case, legal duty, claim or proportionate security and recovery purpose. We review erasure requests manually and assess any lawful need to retain particular records. Closing an account or withdrawing an offer does not automatically erase counterparties' conversations or necessary acceptance evidence.

Verification links are valid for 30 minutes, password-reset links for 15 minutes and sessions for up to eight hours. These limits end their use; they do not mean every related record is deleted then. Password reset invalidates existing sessions. Logs and backup copies have separate retention considerations. The recovery procedure requires erasure decisions to be reapplied before restored service reopens. No fixed deletion or backup-rotation period is promised here.

sections.heading: 5. Cookies and browser storage
sections.text: A necessary secure session cookie keeps members signed in for up to eight hours. Your chosen language is stored in your browser until changed or cleared. Password-reset credentials are not saved in browser storage. Non-essential analytics and marketing tags are disabled.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
sections.text:
Subject to GDPR conditions, you may request access, correction, erasure, restriction or portability. You may object to processing based on legitimate interests; we must then stop unless we demonstrate compelling overriding grounds or need the information for legal claims. Contact info@seedtrade.eu. We verify requests proportionately and protect other people's information when responding.

We normally respond within one month. Any permitted extension of up to two further months is explained within the first month. You may complain to Lithuania's State Data Protection Inspectorate (VDAI) or another competent supervisory authority, including where you live or work. Material changes to this Notice will be communicated as appropriate. English is the authoritative legal language.

sections.text:

Registered address: Varnėnų g. 52, LT-37171 Panevėžys, Lithuania. VAT: LT100017200917. SEEDTRADE.EU is a platform name, not a separate company.

For privacy and service questions, contact the SEEDTRADE.EU team at info@seedtrade.eu.
